pass: longtail diary hygiene — Morytania legs collapse + residual diary near-dups
purpose: Reduce Morytania legs 1-4 bloat to a single equipment ladder with clear tier effects, and file remaining diary near-dup DROP candidates (Fremennik sea boots thin restatement). Does not re-author other peer area-tasks ladders already first-class.

policy.region_rule: Morytania diary legs stay region_hint morytania. Fremennik sea-boots drop is Fremennik-only.
policy.collapse_rule: One ladder equipment row owns all easy/medium/hard/elite skilling effects. Micro-split equipment ids morytania:morytania-legs-1..4 must leave product via DROP_IDS.
policy.id_rule: Emit morytania:morytania-legs-1-4 as the hygiene ladder id (wiki family name). Product already also has peer-style morytania:area-tasks-morytania-legs from diaries-2026-07-26 with equivalent tier text — after sync, product must keep exactly ONE of those two ladder ids (see dual_ladder_resolution).
policy.dual_ladder_resolution: Prefer keep morytania:area-tasks-morytania-legs for peer parity (desert/karamja/wilderness/tirannwn area-tasks-*). If keep area-tasks: NAME_CANONICAL map 'morytania legs 1-4' / this emit name onto area-tasks and DROP this emit id OR skip re-ingest of legs-1-4. If keep this emit: DROP area-tasks. Never keep both ladders plus the four splits.
policy.no_trade_rule: Diary permanent skilling throughput, Prayer/RC/Farming/teleport QoL only. Pure combat damage omitted beyond noted Barrows/Slayer Tower utilities already on hard/elite tiers.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Wiki-stated percent/chance/daily caps only.
policy.wiki_source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Morytania_legs (benefits table: worn / operated / always per tier 1-4)

product_check.audit_align: audit-final-still-missing-2026-07-26 morytania_legs theme: keep area-tasks ladder, drop micro-splits 1-4 (high confidence). This file supplies Option A content for the single ladder and DROP list for sync.

decision.rejected_option_b: morytania:morytania-legs-diary-ladder activity checklist not used — wiki reward is worn equipment; tier effects belong on one equipment row, not a planner activity shell with equipment links
decision.reason: Only diary still micro-split to four equipment rows while peers use single 1-4 ladders. Collapse is low-risk: effects are additive by tier, claim order is linear, no separate obtain paths.

drop_rationale.morytania:morytania-legs-1: Easy-tier slice only; full ladder owns Bloom double-fungi, ghast ignore, +5% Temple Trekking.
drop_rationale.morytania:morytania-legs-2: Medium-tier slice; blood RC, cannonballs, Robin 13, Razmire planks, disease-free Canifis mushrooms, slime tele 5/day live on the ladder.
drop_rationale.morytania:morytania-legs-3: Hard-tier slice; shade Prayer, ghostspeak-passive, Barrows bank/double runes, Robin 26, slime tele 10/day live on the ladder.
drop_rationale.morytania:morytania-legs-4: Elite-tier slice; vyre cremation +50% FM/Prayer, Slayer Tower +10%, prayer renewal 4-dose chance, unlimited slime tele, Robin 39, double mushrooms live on the ladder.
drop_rationale.fremennik:fremennik-sea-boots: Thin diary utility restatement. Keep fremennik:area-tasks-sea-boots (full 1-4 tier ladder from diaries catalog).

name_canonical_peer_parity_note: If dual_ladder_resolution keeps morytania:area-tasks-morytania-legs instead of this emit, retarget the five Morytania name keys above to area-tasks and add this emit id to DROP_IDS.
sync_notes: Add drop_ids_suggest entries to scripts/sync-regional-skilling-unlocks.mjs DROP_IDS, then re-run sync.
DROP of morytania:morytania-legs-1..4 is mandatory for hygiene (this file Option A).
DROP fremennik:fremennik-sea-boots to finish sea-boots near-dup (keep area-tasks-sea-boots).
After DROP, product must not still list both morytania:morytania-legs-1-4 and morytania:area-tasks-morytania-legs — pick one ladder id per dual_ladder_resolution.

Outbound Prefer/links that cited morytania:morytania-legs-1|2|3|4 should resolve via NAME_CANONICAL to the kept ladder (activity rows like mort-myre-fungi-bloom / barrows-chest-skilling-utility may still name tiers in prose).
